Product Overview
This women's linen blend cardigan features an elegant OL commuter style, combining Tencel (Lyocell) and linen fabrics for superior breathability and comfort. The slim-fit cut with a notch lapel design showcases a simple yet fashionable urban charm, perfect for summer daily wear.

Material: Linen, Tencel (Lyocell fiber)
Style: OL Commuter, Elegant
Type: Cardigan, Slim Fit
Color: Midnight Blue
Pattern: Solid Color
Sleeve Type: Long Sleeve
Length: Regular Length (50 cm < Length ≤ 65 cm)

- Size M: Recommended max weight 57.5 kg
